name: edit_toolbar_message
description:
Overwrite the markdown content of an existing message in a toolbar thread.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} comments edit {threadId} {messageId} -m {message} --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

markdown.description: The updated message content in markdown format

teamId.description:
The ID or slug of the team that owns the resource.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool

threadId.description: The thread ID containing the message
